title: The Waystation
subtitle: A recovered-recording space-station mystery under cosmic pressure.
description: In the future, interstellar travel is a walk down the street, with another planet a few weeks away. The crew of waystation Concord - a pit-stop for cargo ships passing through wormholes - discover a strange celestial object, creating something that threatens to enmesh them all. Armed with the recordings of the events, a federal agent scours the logs and entries of the crew in search of the truth behind the unexplained destruction of Concord.
